home.label: Clinic guide
home.title: Internal medicine and dialysis in Seoul | Myeonmok Yonsei Seok
home.description: Find Myeonmok Yonsei Seok Internal Medicine near Myeonmok Station in Jungnang-gu, Seoul. Check outpatient hours, dialysis enquiries and directions in English.
home.h1: Internal medicine and dialysis in Myeonmok, Seoul
home.intro: Myeonmok Yonsei Seok is an internal medicine clinic in Jungnang-gu. Outpatient visits take place on the second floor. The dialysis unit is on the fifth and sixth floors of the same building.

sections.heading: Coming in with a test result?
sections.text: For a general medical concern or a follow-up for diabetes, high blood pressure or high cholesterol, use the outpatient guide. It explains what to bring and which questions to ask before a test.

sections.heading: Arranging dialysis?
sections.text: Start with a phone call if this is your first consultation or you receive dialysis elsewhere. Ask about available appointments, records from your current unit and where to check in.

myeonmok-internal-medicine.label: Internal medicine
myeonmok-internal-medicine.title: Internal medicine near Myeonmok Station | Myeonmok Yonsei Seok
myeonmok-internal-medicine.description: Plan a visit to the second-floor internal medicine clinic in Myeonmok-dong. Find guidance on checkup results, ongoing care and questions to ask before an ultrasound.
myeonmok-internal-medicine.h1: Seeing an internal medicine doctor in Myeonmok-dong
myeonmok-internal-medicine.intro: The outpatient clinic is on the second floor of the Smart Building in Jungnang-gu. It offers internal medicine consultations, including follow-up for chronic conditions.

sections.heading: Bring the reason for your visit
sections.text: If another clinic or a screening center suggested a follow-up, bring the report and its date. A medication list or a prescription with drug names and doses can help the doctor review your history.

sections.heading: Check before arranging a test
sections.text: The clinic lists ultrasound and health screening among its services. Ask which test is available for your concern, whether an appointment is needed and what instructions to follow that day.

sections.heading: Finding the right appointment
sections.text: Tell reception whether you want to discuss symptoms, review test results or continue care. If the appointment is about kidney disease or a dialysis transfer, say so when you call.

chronic-care.label: Diabetes and chronic care
chronic-care.title: Diabetes, blood pressure and cholesterol care | Myeonmok Yonsei Seok
chronic-care.description: Prepare for a diabetes, hypertension or high cholesterol visit in Jungnang-gu, Seoul. See which existing test results, home readings and prescriptions to bring.
chronic-care.h1: Preparing for a diabetes, blood pressure or cholesterol visit
chronic-care.intro: If you are following up on a health screening or continuing treatment in Myeonmok-dong, bring dated results and a list of medicines you currently take.

sections.heading: Diabetes and blood glucose
sections.text: Bring recent glucose or HbA1c results if you have them. If you already keep a glucose diary, mark the time and whether the reading was before or after a meal. Note any questions about your medicines.

sections.heading: High cholesterol and other lipid results
sections.text: Bring the full lipid report, including LDL, HDL and triglycerides if listed. An older report and your current prescriptions give the clinician something to compare with the new figures.

sections.heading: High blood pressure
sections.text: If you measure your blood pressure at home, bring your existing readings with dates and times. Ask how to prepare if you need another test. Confirm fasting and medication instructions with the clinic for your appointment.

jungnang-dialysis.label: Dialysis in Jungnang-gu
jungnang-dialysis.title: Hemodialysis in Jungnang-gu, Seoul | Myeonmok Yonsei Seok
jungnang-dialysis.description: Find the hemodialysis unit in Myeonmok-dong and plan a visit from Sangbong-dong, Mangu-dong or Yongmasan. Check the address, floors and how to ask about sessions.
jungnang-dialysis.intro: The clinic’s dialysis unit is at 398 Myeonmok-ro in Myeonmok-dong, near Myeonmok Station. Call before visiting to ask about a first consultation or a transfer.

sections.heading: Which entrance and floor?
sections.text: Set your map destination to 면목연세석내과 or use the Korean street address below. Outpatient reception is on floor 2 and the dialysis unit occupies floors 5 and 6. When you arrange your visit, ask which floor to go to first.

sections.heading: From Sangbong-dong, Mangu-dong or Yongmasan
sections.text: Choose your home address or departure station as the starting point on the map. If you start near Yongmasan Station, keep Myeonmok Station as the landmark for the clinic. Ask about drop-off or step-free access if you need it.

sections.heading: Confirming a dialysis appointment
sections.text: The outpatient timetable does not give dialysis session times. Ask the unit about availability for the date you need, the records it wants to review and when it can confirm an appointment.

dialysis-consultation.label: First visit or transfer
dialysis-consultation.title: First dialysis consultation or transfer in Seoul | Myeonmok Yonsei Seok
dialysis-consultation.description: Questions to ask before your first hemodialysis consultation or a transfer to the clinic in Myeonmok-dong. Includes records, dates, reception and a printable checklist.
dialysis-consultation.h1: Planning a first dialysis consultation or a transfer
dialysis-consultation.intro: When you call, say whether you are seeking an initial kidney consultation or already receive hemodialysis at another unit. This helps reception direct your enquiry.

sections.heading: Before a first consultation
sections.text: Ask whether a referral, recent test results or a current medication list would help. Confirm the appointment time, the reception floor and how the clinic wants to receive any records.

sections.heading: When changing dialysis units
sections.text: Ask the receiving clinic when it can review your records and confirm a start date. Coordinate the plan with your current dialysis team before changing an existing appointment.

sections.heading: If someone is coming with you
sections.text: Tell the clinic if you are bringing a companion, use a wheelchair or need help communicating. Ask about the entrance, movement between floors and whether a companion can join the consultation.

visit.label: Hours and directions
visit.title: Hours and directions from Myeonmok Station | Myeonmok Yonsei Seok
visit.description: Visit Myeonmok Yonsei Seok at 398 Myeonmok-ro, Seoul, near Exit 2 of Myeonmok Station. Find outpatient hours, the Korean address and the clinic phone number.
visit.intro: The Smart Building stands opposite the Myeonmok Bon-dong Community Service Center. Use the Korean address below in a map app or show it to your driver.

sections.heading: Arriving by subway
sections.text: Use Exit 2 of Myeonmok Station on Line 7 and look for the Smart Building at 398 Myeonmok-ro. If stairs are difficult, check an accessible route from your actual starting point before leaving.

sections.heading: Checking in
sections.text: General outpatient visits take place on floor 2. For a dialysis consultation or treatment session, ask the clinic where to check in. Check the registration cutoff before travelling close to closing time.
